_note: PUBLIC library (library/): essays and dissertations that are free for anyone to read on the site. Only pieces the user has explicitly approved for public, full-text publication go here; members-only Patreon dissertations NEVER go here (they stay in dissertations.json as titles/descriptions only). Fields: slug (URL library/<slug>/), title, description (meta/index line), file (markdown under content/library/, rendered verbatim), release (release-page slug that gets a 'Read the dissertation' link, or null). Rebuild with python3 tools/build_pages.py. Optional: release_label (link text on the release page, default 'Read the dissertation'; shown after any members-only link), omit (exact source paragraphs that are notes, not essay text, left out of the page), members_link {label, url} (shown at the end of the essay). short_title (optional): a shorter name for the browser tab/search title, '<short_title> — Library — bfo.mantis'; the page heading keeps the full title.
